slice: CORS + per-function audit doc (3 of 5 acceptance criteria)

non_blocking_findings.problem: secure-ai authenticates the caller but does not check admin status - any authenticated user can invoke a paid OpenAI call.
non_blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Cost exposure from any logged-in account, not just admins.
non_blocking_findings.required_outcome: Out of scope here. Belongs to #352 (cost controls) and is moot if secure-ai is deleted as vestigial. Recorded in the audit doc.

non_blocking_findings.problem: Shared-secret comparison uses !== rather than a constant-time compare.
non_blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Theoretical timing side channel; low practical risk for a shared secret over a network.
non_blocking_findings.required_outcome: Not addressed - the trigger functions are deliberately untouched in this PR. Noted for a future hardening pass.

verification_performed.result: 3 modified (analytics-proxy, secure-ai, vsa-ai-assistant), 2 new untracked (supabase/functions/_shared/cors.ts, docs/edge-function-security-audit.md). No file outside the planned set.

verification_performed.check: git diff on both trigger-* functions (hard constraint)

verification_performed.result: Exactly one, inside _shared/cors.ts. The '*' in analytics-proxy and the invalid comma-joined value in secure-ai are both gone.

verification_performed.check: analytics-proxy jsonResponse signature change threaded through ALL call sites
verification_performed.result: Manually enumerated: definition at :16 plus calls at :122, :204, :234. All three pass req as first arg. Zero missed call sites.

Shared module defaults (allowlist of 4 origins, DEFAULT_ORIGIN, allowed headers/methods strings, Vary: Origin) match the original inline implementation exactly. Called with no options, so allowCredentials is falsy and no credentials header is emitted - matching the original.
Local wrapper calls sharedCorsHeaders(req, { allowCredentials: true }). Credentials are now only ever paired with a single concrete origin, never '*'.

verification_performed.note: See baseline comparison below - NOT introduced by this branch.

verification_performed.note: PRE-EXISTING on main. This branch introduces ZERO new type errors. Exactly the gap #296 exists to close.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: analytics-proxy '*' removed; secure-ai invalid comma-joined ACAO removed; both now use the shared allowlist. trigger-* correctly have no CORS.

closes_issue_reasoning: 2 of 5 acceptance criteria are external blockers. PR references #229 but must NOT close it.
pr_state_reasoning: Touches Supabase Edge Functions that hold secrets and perform privileged actions. Narrowing CORS can break a legitimate browser caller. Requires manual `supabase functions deploy` and human verification against the real admin analytics page and Ask VSA before it is live.
